@graph.headline: Notion vs ClickUp: Features and Pricing
@graph.description: Compare Notion vs ClickUp for docs, wikis, tasks, project views, free plans, paid pricing and AI features before you choose a team workspace.

itemListElement.name: Notion vs ClickUp: Features and Pricing

mainEntity.name: Is Notion or ClickUp better for project management?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClickUp is usually the better fit when tasks, deadlines, sprints, Gantt views, time tracking and dashboards are the main work. Notion is stronger when project information needs to sit beside flexible docs, wikis and databases.

ClickUp's official FAQ lists Unlimited at US$7 per user per month and Business at US$12 when billed yearly. Notion lists Plus at US$10 and Business at US$20 per member per month. Compare billing, AI add-ons, guests and storage before deciding.

mainEntity.name: Which tool is better for documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion is a better starting point for teams that want flexible pages, linked databases and a wiki in one workspace. ClickUp Docs works well when documentation needs to stay close to assigned tasks and project work.

mainEntity.name: Can Notion and ClickUp work together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both offer integrations and APIs. A team can keep its knowledge base in Notion and manage assigned work in ClickUp, but it should decide which tool owns each record to avoid duplicate updates.

mainEntity.name: Can I move a Notion workspace into ClickUp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not expect a perfect one-click copy. Export Notion pages and databases, test a small sample, then rebuild task relationships, views, formulas, permissions and automations that do not transfer as native ClickUp objects.
